༄༅/ /rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa las/rta mgrin nag po'i dbang chog dregs pa srog gi rgya can skur ba'i cho ga dbang chen thugs kyi tshal pa zhes bya ba bzhug

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa las/ rta mgrin nag po'i dbang chog dregs pa srog gi rgya can skur ba'i cho ga dbang chen thugs kyi tshal pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//
na mo gu ru ma hen+d+ra kro dhā ya/ srid gsum dbang sgyur thod phreng rtsal// dbang chen drag po'i skur ston pa// mi bzad rta yi zhal can la// gus pas 'dud do gnang ba stsol//

rta nag dregs pa'i srog dbang brgyud 'dzin gyi bu la chig brgyud du bskur ba'i tshe/ sbyor ba dkyil 'khor dbus su chos 'byung mthing nag zla gam dmar po/ de rgyab rtsibs bzhi nag po mu khyud thod phreng gis bskor ba sgo rdzogs khro dkyil spyi 'gre ltar bya ba'am/ dar ras mthing nag gi steng du 'bru nag gi tshom bu lnga/ de rgyab mgron thabs lha'i tshom bu ci rigs bkod kyang chog pa gzhung gi dgongs pa yin zhing*/ de dag gang rung gi steng du mañji la bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings mthing nag kha rgyan gzungs rdor bcas pa'i steng du 'phrul stegs la/ spod kyis bran pa'i dpal gtor rin chen 'bar ba rta mgos spras pa rgyan dang dar gdugs mthing gas spras pa bsham/ gzhan yang sku tsag /phyag mtshan ral gri dang lcags kyu zhags pa/ glang ko zhing lpags stag sham thod phreng*/ sngags byang rnams ci bder bkod/ sman rag gtor gsum/ phyi mchod rnams spyi ltar bsham/ las bum/ mig dar me tog sogs 'du bya'o// dngos gzhi skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas sgrub thabs ltar tshig ris gcig gis bdag mdun bum pa gtor ma'i lha so sor bskyed pa'am/ rtogs dgongs dang ldan na de dag dbyer med du bskyed kyang rung la/ dmigs pa'i spro bsdu spyi mthun bcas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya zhing bum gtor la lha yang yang bstim/ mthar spyan 'dren bstod bskul dbang len bcas grub pa dang*/

las bum nang du pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ljang sngon sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ khro 'dzum dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing phyed skyil du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum pa gang bar gyur/
ces mos la/
na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ badz+ra pā ṇi lam+bo dha ra/ a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ
ces bzla/
lha 'od du zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi las thams cad sgrub pa'i nus ldan du gyur/
de nas slob ma brgyud 'dzin gcig gam/ nyams su len nges kyi skal ldan lnga las mi mang ba khrus nas dbyung*/
sum+bha ni
sa bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/

de'ang gsung rdo rje 'od dpag tu med pa nyid gdul bya sa la gnas pa rnams la 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang*/ thun mong ba'i gdul bya'i snang ngor rig 'dzin gyi gtso mchog rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyi skur bstan cing*/ zhi bas mi 'dul ba rnams la dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po dang*/ shin tu mi srun pa'i gdug pa can 'dul ba'i gnyen por de nyid rta mgrin nag po drag tu khros pa che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skur bzhengs nas/ snyigs dus kyi sde brgyad dregs pa mthu bo che'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod zil gyis gnon pa'i phrin las la gnyen po stobs kyi phyag rgya gang gis bsgrun du med pa ste/ de'i sgrub thabs gter kha 'ga' zhig nas byon pa las/ skabs su babs pa 'di ni gzhung rtsa ba las/ o rgyan bdag gi thugs bcud dam pa 'di: da lta'i dus su spel ba'i gnas med pas: ma 'ongs dus na 'dzam gling bod kyi yul: klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen dbang byas te: mdze dang gag lhog smyo 'bog brgyal nad sogs: mi rnams mi bde sna tshogs gtong bar byed: de lta'i dus su 'phrad chog thob chog 'di: thugs kyi mdzod brtol ma 'ongs don phyir sbas: zhes dang*/ rta mgrin nag po lcags ral sgrub pa'i skor: dbus dang phyogs bzhir gter kha lnga ru sbas: de dag kun gyi zab rgyas mthar thug 'di: mkha' ris gdan drangs mon mkhar steng bzhugs tshe:

a tsar ye shes bka' yi yi ge mkhan: bse sgrom smug po snod kyi nang du bstsal: gnam skas brag la thugs kyi yang gter sbas: zhes bka'i gtsigs su bsngags par mdzad pa'i zab chos dbang chen gsang ba 'dus pa yang gsang drag po'i sgrub lugs/ chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i zab gter las byon pa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha khyad par du 'phags pa yin la/ de'i srog dbang dregs pa srog gi rgya can bsgrub par bgyi ba la
sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/
ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang ldan par mtshon byed du mig dar bkab cing*/ lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du rin po che'i cod pan lag tu thogs par mos shig /
mig dar me tog sbyin/

me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye: bla ma dbang chen he ru ka: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bdag nyid che: gsang ba gsum la mnga' mdzad pa: khyed ni che btsan 'gran zla bral: bdag cag dbang gi rjes 'jug pa'i: las dang skal bar ldan pa nyid: dam tshig chen por bdag dbang skur: gtso bos yang dag bzung ba dang: lhag pa'i lha ru mdzad du gsol:
lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/

legs 'ongs rigs kyi bu rnams nyon: khams gsum 'di na dbang chen dang: dregs pa srog gi bdag po ste: dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po yin: 'di ni bka' gnyan ches gsang ba: bka' dang dam la mi gnas na: dregs pa'i 'khor gyis rang srog gcod: tshul bzhin bsgrub par cang nus sam: skal bar ldan na gnang bar bya: zhes dris pa'i lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ni: bdag cag rab tu mnos gyur te: tshul bzhin sgrub la bka' mi 'da': dbang chen khyod kyis rjes bzung 'tshal: bla ma dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor tha dad med pa dbang chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la dkon mchog rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su mchi'o snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams : sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi:
lan gsum/

thabs khyad par can du gyur pa gsag sbyong yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin bya ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ rang rig lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'gags rang gsal mchod pa 'bul: mu bzhir ltung ba mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes yi rang: 'khor ba dong nas sprug par bskul: ka dag zang thal rjen par bzhugs: kun kyang rang rig rtogs par bsngo: sku gsum yongs rdzogs thob par shog:
gsum mam gcig /

mkha' khyab kyi skye rgu thams cad dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed zab mo gsan la grol byed lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la blo bzhag bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ma: bdag gis 'gro kun bsgral bya'i phyir: rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i phyir: tshad med bzhi ru sems bskyed do:
lan gsum/

tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'du byas la/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid rang gi tshe rabs nas 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha la phog par shog cig snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du dor la 'di'i rjes zlos/ hūm̐: rang byung dbyings nas grub pa'i lha: tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang dang ldan: 'brel pa'i me tog lha la 'bul: phrin las 'grub par mdzad du gsol:
ces 'dor du gzhug /
ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig /
rdo rjes mig dar bsal la/
kye: ma rig 'khrul pas rab bsgribs pas: ye shes snang ba'i sgo bcad pa: ye shes 'char ba'i sgo nyid du: yang dag thabs dang ldan pas dbye: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa:
las bum gyis dam chu sbyin la/

hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: nyams na sreg cing 'tshed pa ste: ma nyams rang byung ye shes sems: dag pa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nyid: yang dag par ni snang bar 'gyur: de phyir 'da' bar mi bya ste: mi phyed rdo rje'i bro bor cig: tha tshig las mi 'da' ba rdo rje'i bro bor bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ badz+ra i dan dhu ri: rak+ṣa si rak+ṣa si sa ma ya:
gnas gsum du rdo rje bzhag la/
oṃ āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya mi ti hūm̐ dza:
rdo rje phreng ba dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/

hūm̐: tshur shog rgyal ba'i sras chen po: de ring dbang chen nag po dang: khyod nyid gnyis su med gyur te: bdag ni pad+ma he ru ka: khro bo'i rgyal po 'jigs su rung: khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam gnas shing: rdo rje'i gnas ni khyed kyis srungs:
yang las bum gyi chu bdud rtsi dang bcas pa ngag tu blud/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/
hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i tshul ston pa: khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang: 'di yi snying la yang dag zhugs: byin rlabs chen po mdzad du gsol:
skabs 'dir phyis kyi brgyud pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar ye shes 'bebs pa'i cho ga byed na/ las sngags dang las chus bsang*/
swa bhā ba
sa sbyang*/
stong pa'i ngang las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus su bdud bzhi dang klu rigs lnga bsnol ba'i steng nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ khyed rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥmathing nag
sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/
zhes brjod pa las: khyed rang skad cig gis rta mgrin nag po:
sogs nas/

'joms par byed pa: me dpung dmar nag rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na i ha ha'i sgra sgrog pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥmathing nag /de dag las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dang*/ bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal yas nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs/ khyed rang gi sgo gsum la chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin dbyer med du thim nas byin gyis brlabs par mos shig /hūm̐ hrī: bde chen dbang drag
sogs spyan 'dren dang*/ rtsa sngags la/
badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā/
btags pa brjod cing gu gul tshil chen sogs spos dang rol mo'i sgra drag po bcas byin dbab/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/
hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: sku gsung mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gnas: dbang chen khros pa'i tshul bstan pa: 'di la yang dag gnas par mdzod: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā:
zhes gnas shing brtan par bya'o// de nas dbang dngos la bum pa dang gtor ma ma bral bar spyi bor btegs la/

dbang bskur dngos la 'dun pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rnam pa bum pa dang gtor ma la: ngo bo rta mgrin nag po 'khor rta mgrin rigs bzhi dang bcas pa: 'ur 'ur thug thug chems chems: rta skad thengs gsum tser tser bton pas: stong gsum 'ur 'ur: rgya mtsho khyoms khyoms ri rab ldeg ldeg drag shul dang bcas khyed rang gi spyi bor byon par bsam: gang gi nus pa yongs su rdzogs pas khyed rang la dbang bskur bas: klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po sde brgyad thams cad kha 'dar snying 'dar: brgyal 'bog myos lkugs rengs 'dar yed yed: mig hrig hrig: bka' nyan las byed bro bor dam las mi 'da' bar bsam: 'ga' zhig ni rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bros te phyir mi ldog par mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang: me dpung gis chod par sgoms shig: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i tshul ston pa: khro bo chen po gshegs su gsol: sprul pa'i khro rgyal gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: sku yi sgo nas dbang mchog skur: lus kyi nad gdon zhi bar mdzod: gsung gi sgo nas dbang mchog skur: ngag la nus pa bskyed du gsol: thugs kyi sgo nas dbang mchog skur: yid la bde stong spar du gsol: yon tan sgo nas dbang mchog skur: mthu stobs rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: phrin las sgo nas dbang mchog skur:

nad gdon bgegs rnams tshar gcod cig: bum pa'i dbang bskur gzhal yas chen po'i mchog: gtor ma'i dbang bskur lha dang gnyis su med: rta mchog sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin: ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bzhi mchog: skal ldan bu la dus 'dir yongs rdzogs nas: sku bzhi lhun grub phrin las rnam bzhi brnyes: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐: e ā ral+li hūm̐ hrīḥdza: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: wā ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrī:
zhes gnas bzhir gtug cing*/

ho: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la bum pa gtor ma dang bcas pa'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par bskur pas: lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs su smin nas 'bras bu sku bzhi'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig: sbyor ba phrin las rnam pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig:
ces brjod la/

bum chu spyi bor blugs pas rta mgos mtshan nas rta skad thengs gsum bton par sgoms shig: ngag tu blud pas nus pa thogs pa med par sgoms shig: 'gugs sgrol drag po'i phyag mtshan dang dpal gyi chas gos rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas srid pa gsum na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i phrin las la mnga' dbang sgyur bar mos shig:
lag g.yas su ral gri /g.yon du lcags kyu dang zhags pa gtad la/

hūm̐: ral gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod: bgegs rnams dum bur gtubs par byed: me chen 'bar bas dug lnga sreg: lcags kyus dgra bgegs snying nas 'dren: zhags pas nyon mongs 'ching zhing sdom: dbang chen dpal gyi phyag mtshan 'di: skal ldan khyod la gtad pa yis: mthu stobs ma lus yongs rdzogs nas: phrin las gang brtsam 'grub par shog: oṃ badz+ra tig+na pā sha dz+wa la raṃ a bhi ṣiñca hrī: ho: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la dbang chen khro bo'i phyag mtshan 'di gtad pas: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig:
de nas ko rlon dang zhing lpags bkon la/

theg chen stobs bcu yongs su rdzogs: rtog med 'khor ba kun las sgrol: dpal chen sku yi rgyan du che: khro rgyal rtags kyi dbang thob nas: dregs pa bran du khol bar shog: oṃ badz+ra hasti badz+ra ti ra badz+ra māṃ:
zhes brjod stag sham bkon la/
bdag 'dzin ru dra dbyings su bsgral: stag sham 'di ni dpa' ba'i rtags: dregs pa'i tshogs la dbang yang sgyur: khro chen brgyad kyi dbang thob shog: badz+ra rak+sha pra ti ni laṃ badz+ra māṃ:
de nas thod phreng bkon la/

hūm̐: bdag 'dzin ru dra dbyings su bsgral: 'khor 'das skye shi rtsad nas gcod: 'du byed lnga bcu yongs su dag: khro rgyal sku yi rgyan du che: khams gsum dbang du 'du ba dang: srid gsum bran du khol bar shog: badz+ra ki sha ho:
zhes rim par bskur/

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral ba nas rang 'dra'i khro bo sku chung la yan lag rdzogs pa/ mgrin pa nas sngags kyi phreng ba/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba nam mkha' khengs pa tsam du byon nas/ khyed rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dbang dang byin rlabs rtsal rdzogs su thob/ lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor la dbang*/ phrin las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i mthu thob par mos shig /
sku spyi bo/ sngags byang mgrin pa/ phyag mtshan lag tu gtad la/

hūm̐: sku ni snang ba gzung 'dzin med: gsung ni mi 'gag rdo rje'i sgra: thugs ni mi rtog ye shes ngang: yon tan re ba ma lus skong: phrin las thogs med thams cad sgrub: ma lus 'dus pa'i dbang chen po: yongs rdzogs khyod kyis thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:
zhes brjod la dpal gtor gyi cha shas dngos grub tu sbyin cing shis brjod ci ltar rigs pa bya/
de rnams kyis dbang chen rta mgrin nag po'i dbang bskur thun mong ma yin pa dregs pa srog gi rgya can legs par grub pa yin pas

sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la dam tshig khas blang sogs dbang gi rjes rim spyi ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod nongs bshags gshegs bsdu shis brjod la sogs pa'ang gsang ba spyi'i 'gros bzhin shes par bya'o// nyon mongs rnam 'gyur srid gsum dregs tshogs kyi// srog la dbang thob rdo rje srin po'i sku /bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun gyis yongs grub nas// 'khor 'das phyag rgya gcig tu rdzogs gyur cig /ces zab gnyan byin rlabs kyi tshan kha dang ldan cing mchog dman kun la nyer mkho'i bdud rtsir gyur pa 'di'ang*/ nye bar mkho ba'i mdzod chen gyi chos sder 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa rtsal gyis bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //
